summary: The Ensuring Excellence in Mental Health Act adjusts coverage, payment systems, grants, data infrastructure, and legal protections for Certified Community Behavioral Health Clinics (CCBHCs) under the Medicare and Medicaid programs.

affected_groups.effect: Gain access to expanded behavioral health clinic services, prospective payment structures, waived deductibles for specific Medicare services, and person-centered care options.
Subject to new prospective payment systems, cost reporting, data infrastructure reporting, accreditation standards, and become eligible for operating grants and technical assistance.
Receive liability protections under the Federal Tort Claims Act.

key_provisions: Establishes a prospective payment system for CCBHC services under the Medicaid program beginning in fiscal year 2026.
Expands the scope and demonstration programs of CCBHC services under Medicaid to include additional person-centered and primary health services.

Adds coverage for CCBHC services under the Medicare program beginning January 1, 2027, with payments set at 80 percent of the lesser of actual charges or prospective payment amounts without applying Part B deductibles.
Authorizes operating grants, technical assistance, and data infrastructure systems for community behavioral health clinics from fiscal years 2026 through 2030.
Creates a formal accreditation option and process for CCBHCs utilizing approved private nonprofit accreditation bodies.
Extends liability protections under the Federal Tort Claims Act to clinicians working in certified community behavioral health clinics.
missing_information: Specific dollar amounts for prospective payment rates, as these are delegated to the Secretary or individual states.
Exact geographic distribution details of where grants will be prioritized beyond broad criteria.
summary_detail.plain_summary: The Ensuring Excellence in Mental Health Act adjusts coverage, payment systems, grants, data infrastructure, and legal protections for Certified Community Behavioral Health Clinics (CCBHCs) under the Medicare and Medicaid programs.
summary_detail.significance: This bill modifies the financing, regulatory oversight, and legal protections for community mental health centers across the federal Medicare and Medicaid programs.
